<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="12" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.08"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F7F7F8"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="218" fill="#EBEBEB"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="20" y="23" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#323232">9:41</text>
  <line x1="326" y1="17" x2="326" y2="22" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="330" y1="14" x2="330" y2="22" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="334" y1="11" x2="334" y2="22" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="338" y1="8" x2="338" y2="22" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M347 16 Q352 11 357 16 M350 19 Q352 17 354 19" fill="none" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="352" cy="21" r="1.5" fill="#323232"/>
  <rect x="365" y="11" width="19" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="367" y="13" width="14" height="7" rx="1" fill="#323232"/>
  <rect x="384" y="14" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#323232"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <polyline points="31,64 22,73 31,82" fill="none" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="52" y="78" font-family="Roboto" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Check-in</text>
  <circle cx="355" cy="73" r="17" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
  <circle cx="355" cy="68" r="4.2" fill="#7A1851"/>
  <ellipse cx="355" cy="78" rx="8" ry="4.5" fill="#7A1851"/>
  <text x="24" y="119" font-family="Roboto" font-size="30" font-weight="600" fill="#1F1E29">Ready for takeoff?</text>
  <text x="24" y="145" font-family="Roboto" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5E65">Complete your check-in in a few easy steps.</text>

  <!-- main white panel shadow and panel -->
  <rect x="14" y="174" width="362" height="616" rx="24" fill="#000000" opacity="0.06"/>
  <rect x="14" y="170" width="362" height="616" rx="24" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>

  <!-- step progress -->
  <text x="32" y="202" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#949499">STEP 1 OF 3</text>
  <text x="315" y="202" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">33%</text>
  <rect x="32" y="212" width="326" height="6" rx="3" fill="#EBEBEB"/>
  <rect x="32" y="212" width="108" height="6" rx="3" fill="#DB6186"/>

  <!-- flight card -->
  <rect x="28" y="236" width="334" height="128" rx="16" fill="#FFD3D1" opacity="0.55"/>
  <text x="44" y="260" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">UPCOMING FLIGHT</text>
  <text x="44" y="288" font-family="Roboto" font-size="21" font-weight="600" fill="#1F1E29">New York</text>
  <text x="44" y="310" font-family="Roboto" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5E65">JFK</text>
  <line x1="91" y1="301" x2="190" y2="301" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polygon points="190,301 181,296 181,306" fill="#7A1851"/>
  <circle cx="95" cy="301" r="3.5" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="207" y="288" font-family="Roboto" font-size="21" font-weight="600" fill="#1F1E29">London</text>
  <text x="207" y="310" font-family="Roboto" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5E65">LHR</text>
  <line x1="44" y1="330" x2="346" y2="330" stroke="#FFB7B8" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="44" y="350" font-family="Roboto" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#323232">Fri, 18 Oct 2026</text>
  <text x="246" y="350" font-family="Roboto" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#323232">08:40 · Flight AP 214</text>

  <!-- title and passenger info -->
  <text x="32" y="397" font-family="Roboto" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Passenger details</text>
  <text x="32" y="420" font-family="Roboto" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5E65">Enter the details exactly as shown on your booking.</text>

  <!-- booking reference field -->
  <text x="32" y="449" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#323232">BOOKING REFERENCE</text>
  <rect x="32" y="458" width="326" height="52" rx="9" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <text x="48" y="490" font-family="Roboto" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#1F1E29">K7P4QX</text>
  <polyline points="331,480 336,485 345,475" fill="none" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="32" y="528" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">6 characters · Found in your confirmation email</text>

  <!-- surname field -->
  <text x="32" y="558" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#323232">PASSENGER SURNAME</text>
  <rect x="32" y="567" width="326" height="52" rx="9" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <text x="48" y="599" font-family="Roboto" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#1F1E29">Miller</text>
  <polyline points="331,589 336,594 345,584" fill="none" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="32" y="637" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Use the surname listed on your travel document</text>

  <!-- continue button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="32" y="663" width="326" height="52" rx="26" fill="#7A1851"/>
    <text x="177" y="696" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Continue to check-in</text>
    <polyline points="294,689 300,695 294,701" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- help row -->
  <circle cx="47" cy="743" r="11" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
  <text x="47" y="748" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#7A1851">?</text>
  <text x="67" y="747" font-family="Roboto" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5E65">Need help finding your booking?</text>
  <text x="274" y="747" font-family="Roboto" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#DB6186">Help centre</text>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="778" width="390" height="66" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="778" x2="390" y2="778" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,797 49,788 59,797 59,808 52,808 52,801 46,801 46,808 39,808" fill="#949499"/>
    <text x="49" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="127" cy="797" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="134" y1="804" x2="140" y2="810" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="127" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Explore</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="181" y="786" width="66" height="32" rx="16" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
    <rect x="201" y="792" width="26" height="17" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="204" y1="796" x2="224" y2="796" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="204" y1="801" x2="216" y2="801" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="214" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">Trips</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="333" cy="794" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="333" cy="806" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="333" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
